extension_description.message: Save Instagram photos and videos, and X videos, directly to Photos.

popupInstruction.message: Tap the download button beside Send on Instagram or Share on an X video post to save all its media to Photos.

footerNote.message: Photos and videos are saved to this device’s Photos library.

photosFirstSave.message: Photos will ask for access on the first save

photosDenied.message: Allow Photos access for Downloader in Settings

photosRestricted.message: Photos access is restricted on this device

carouselUnavailable.message: Could not read every carousel slide. Open the post, wait for it to load, then try again.

noMedia.message: No downloadable media found in this post.

postURLUnavailable.message: Could not find the post link. Open the post, then try again.

processingVideo.message: Processing video… This may take a few minutes.

retryDownload.message: Tap again to retry failed items.

downloadFailed.message: Download failed. Tap again to retry.

resolveFailed.message: The built-in video engine could not process this post.

nativeUnavailable.message: Downloader could not reach the native extension. Enable the extension and reopen Safari.

videoExplanation.message: yt-dlp runs inside the extension on this device. Instagram media is read directly from the post when available.

videoEngineReady.message: Ready to process videos on this device

videoEngineUnavailable.message: The built-in video engine is unavailable. Reinstall or update Downloader.

invalidVideoResult.message: The built-in video engine returned an invalid media list.

unsafeVideoURL.message: The built-in video engine returned an unsupported media URL.

instagramSessionNote.message: For Instagram downloads on this device. Sign in in your current Safari profile, allow Downloader access to Instagram, then sync. Private browsing and other profiles are not included automatically.

instagramCookiesUnavailable.message: Safari 18 or later is required. Allow Downloader access to Instagram in Safari, then retry syncing.

instagramSessionMissing.message: Sign in at instagram.com in your current Safari profile, allow Downloader access to the site, then sync again.

invalidInstagramSession.message: The login could not be synced safely. Sign in to Instagram in Safari, then try syncing again.

instagramSessionFailed.message: Could not sync Instagram login. Make sure Downloader is enabled in Safari, then try again.
